title: Rava bar Tuvia bar Yitzchak
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He spoke in the name of Rav, [Eruvin 28a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.28b.21). Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim omits bar Tuvia and judges this correct, identifying him with the well-known Rabbah bar Rav Yitzchak.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The heading has Rava bar Tuvia bar Yitzchak; Hyman’s proposed identification is Rabbah bar Rav Yitzchak. The omitted Tuvia and differing Rav father title remain explicit in that attributed proposal.

The link opens 28b, where the Gemara names Rabbah bar Toviyya bar Yitzchak transmitting Rav’s answer. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3151&lang=en) also lists that chain at 28b. Hyman cites 28a, reports omission of bar Tuvia from Dikdukei Soferim and endorses that reading.
